steps.name: Install dependencies Ubuntu
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends openssl build-essential libmariadb-dev-compat libpq-dev libssl-dev pkg-config

# Pass the MariaDB client library to mysqlclient-sys through its environment variables.
# When it finds the library with pkg-config, its build script makes cargo rerun it whenever
# anything in the library directory changes, and the install above changes that directory on
# every run. So every MySQL build recompiled mysqlclient-sys, diesel and diesel_migrations,
# even with a cached build. Cargo compares environment variables by their value instead.
lib_dir="$(pkg-config --variable=libdir mysqlclient)"
version="$(pkg-config --modversion mysqlclient)"
{
  echo "MYSQLCLIENT_NO_PKG_CONFIG=1"
  echo "LIBMARIADB_NO_PKG_CONFIG=1"
  echo "MYSQLCLIENT_LIB_DIR=${lib_dir}"
  echo "MYSQLCLIENT_VERSION=${version}"
} | tee -a "${GITHUB_ENV}"

steps.name: Init Variables
steps.run:
if [[ "${CHANNEL}" == 'rust-toolchain' ]]; then
  RUST_TOOLCHAIN="$(grep -m1 -oP 'channel.*"(\K.*?)(?=")' rust-toolchain.toml)"
elif [[ "${CHANNEL}" == 'msrv' ]]; then
  RUST_TOOLCHAIN="$(grep -m1 -oP 'rust-version\s.*"(\K.*?)(?=")' Cargo.toml)"
else
  RUST_TOOLCHAIN="${CHANNEL}"
fi
echo "RUST_TOOLCHAIN=${RUST_TOOLCHAIN}" | tee -a "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

steps.name: Install toolchain ${{steps.toolchain.outputs.RUST_TOOLCHAIN}} as default
steps.run:
# Remove the rust-toolchain.toml
rm rust-toolchain.toml

# Install the correct toolchain version
rustup toolchain install "${RUST_TOOLCHAIN}" --profile minimal --no-self-update

# If this matrix is the `rust-toolchain` flow, also install rustfmt and clippy
if [[ "${CHANNEL}" == 'rust-toolchain' ]]; then
  rustup component add --toolchain "${RUST_TOOLCHAIN}" rustfmt clippy
fi

# Set as the default toolchain
rustup default "${RUST_TOOLCHAIN}"

pipelines.name: Release

steps.name: Normalize architecture string
steps.run:
# Replace slashes with nothing to create a safe string for paths/cache keys
NORMALIZED_ARCH="${MATRIX_ARCH//\/}"
echo "NORMALIZED_ARCH=${NORMALIZED_ARCH}" | tee -a "${GITHUB_ENV}"

steps.name: Determine Source Version
steps.run:
# Get the Source Version for this release
GIT_EXACT_TAG="$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 --exact-match 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [[ -n "${GIT_EXACT_TAG}" ]]; then
    echo "SOURCE_VERSION=${GIT_EXACT_TAG}" | tee -a "${GITHUB_ENV}"
else
    GIT_LAST_TAG="$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)"
    echo "SOURCE_VERSION=${GIT_LAST_TAG}-${SOURCE_COMMIT:0:8}" | tee -a "${GITHUB_ENV}"
fi

steps.name: Configure build cache from/to
steps.run:
#
# Check if there is a GitHub Container Registry Login and use it for caching
if [[ -n "${GHCR_REPO}" ]]; then
  echo "BAKE_CACHE_FROM=type=registry,ref=${GHCR_REPO}-buildcache:${BASE_IMAGE}-${NORMALIZED_ARCH}" | tee -a "${GITHUB_ENV}"
  echo "BAKE_CACHE_TO=type=registry,ref=${GHCR_REPO}-buildcache:${BASE_IMAGE}-${NORMALIZED_ARCH},compression=zstd,mode=max" | tee -a "${GITHUB_ENV}"
else
  echo "BAKE_CACHE_FROM="
  echo "BAKE_CACHE_TO="
fi
#

steps.name: Generate tags
steps.run:
# Convert comma-separated list to newline-separated set commands
TAGS=$(echo "${CONTAINER_REGISTRIES}" | tr ',' '\n' | sed "s|.*|*.tags=&|")

# Output for use in next step
{
  echo "TAGS<<EOF"
  echo "$TAGS"
  echo "EOF"
} >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Rename binaries to match target platform
Determine Base Tags
steps.run:
# Check which main tag we are going to build determined by ref_type
if [[ "${REF_TYPE}" == "tag" ]]; then
  echo "BASE_TAGS=latest${BASE_IMAGE_TAG},${GITHUB_REF#refs/*/}${BASE_IMAGE_TAG}${BASE_IMAGE_TAG//-/,}" | tee -a "${GITHUB_ENV}"
elif [[ "${REF_TYPE}" == "branch" ]]; then
  echo "BASE_TAGS=testing${BASE_IMAGE_TAG}" | tee -a "${GITHUB_ENV}"
fi

steps.name: Create manifest list, push it and extract digest SHA
steps.run:
IFS=',' read -ra IMAGES <<< "${CONTAINER_REGISTRIES}"
IFS=',' read -ra TAGS <<< "${BASE_TAGS}"

TAG_ARGS=()
for img in "${IMAGES[@]}"; do
  for tag in "${TAGS[@]}"; do
    TAG_ARGS+=("-t" "${img}:${tag}")
  done
done

echo "Creating manifest"
if ! OUTPUT=$(docker buildx imagetools create \
                "${TAG_ARGS[@]}" \
                $(printf "${IMAGES[0]}@sha256:%s " *) 2>&1); then
  echo "Manifest creation failed"
  echo "${OUTPUT}"
  exit 1
fi

echo "Manifest created successfully"
echo "${OUTPUT}"

# Extract digest SHA for subsequent steps
GET_DIGEST_SHA="$(echo "${OUTPUT}" | grep -oE 'sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}' | tail -1)"
echo "DIGEST_SHA=${GET_DIGEST_SHA}" | tee -a "${GITHUB_ENV}"

steps.name: Install dependencies Ubuntu
steps.run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential libssl-dev pkg-config

steps.name: Pick the SDK
steps.run:
if [[ -n "${NPM_VERSION}" && -n "${GIT_REF}" ]]; then
  echo "::error::Give an npm version or a git ref, not both"
  exit 1
fi
if [[ -n "${GIT_REF}" ]]; then
  {
    echo "source=git"
    echo "ref=${GIT_REF}"
  } >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
  echo "SDK: bitwarden/sdk-internal \`${GIT_REF}\`, built from source" >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"
  exit 0
fi
spec="${NPM_VERSION:-latest}"
if [[ ! "${spec}" =~ ^[0-9A-Za-z.+-]+$ ]]; then
  echo "::error::That is not an npm version or tag"
  exit 1
fi
manifest="$(curl -fsS --retry 3 "https://registry.npmjs.org/@bitwarden%2Fsdk-internal/${spec}")"
version="$(jq -r .version <<< "${manifest}")"
commit="$(jq -r .gitHead <<< "${manifest}")"
if [[ ! "${commit}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
  echo "::error::@bitwarden/sdk-internal@${version} doesn't name the commit it was built from"
  exit 1
fi
{
  echo "source=npm"
  echo "version=${version}"
  echo "ref=${commit}"
} >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
echo "SDK: @bitwarden/sdk-internal ${version} from npm, e2e tests at ${commit}" >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"

steps.name: Install toolchains
steps.run:
rustup toolchain install
if [[ "${SDK_SOURCE}" == git ]]; then
  cd sdk-internal
  rustup toolchain install
  rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown
  rustup component add rust-src
fi

steps.name: Download the SDK package
steps.run:
# npm checks the tarball against the registry's checksum
tarball="$(npm pack "@bitwarden/sdk-internal@${SDK_VERSION}" --pack-destination "${RUNNER_TEMP}" --json | jq -r '.[0].filename')"
package_dir=sdk-internal/crates/bitwarden-wasm-internal/npm
tar -xzf "${RUNNER_TEMP}/${tarball}" --strip-components=1 -C "${package_dir}"
if [[ "$(cat "${package_dir}/VERSION")" != "${SDK_COMMIT}" ]]; then
  echo "::error::The package's VERSION doesn't match its commit ${SDK_COMMIT}"
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Run the SDK live tests
steps.run:
args=(--sdk-dir sdk-internal)
if [[ "${SDK_SOURCE}" == npm ]]; then
  args+=(--skip-sdk-build)
fi
tools/sdk-live-tests/run.sh "${args[@]}"
